title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is an 81-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well today and denies any acute shortness of breath, significant fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He is aware of his condition and is currently managing his symptoms at home. He reports adherence to his prescribed medication regimen and denies any new side effects.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Furosemide 40mg daily
Sevelamer 800mg with meals

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Lower extremities show no significant edema. Blood pressure is 138/82 mmHg.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 4. Recent laboratory results indicate an eGFR of 22 mL/min/1.73m², confirming the progression of his renal function.

Plan
Continue current medications as prescribed. Monitor potassium levels and renal function. Follow up in three months for repeat lab work and clinical evaluation.

Electronically signed, J. Lindqvist, PA-C
